subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Only 3 people sit between D and F when counted from the right of D. E and G are both immediate neighbours of A. B sits immediately to the left of C. Only 1 person sits between B and G when counted from the right of G. What is the position of E with respect to G?
solution:
**Given: **A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table facing away from the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

Only 3 people sit between D and F when counted from the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/785dae773fe80a3c093f6d20f7efec8bc11934c39cdc15b011133f4684e54065.png] 

E and G are both immediate neighbours of A. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfa8eab9ce0801765fe880bc5ebceef30cd8899eec18a4664df4ba08e6c4a025.png] 

Only 1 person sits between B and G when counted from the right of G.B sits immediately to the left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e56b5ed18959c0bf708c574380771aedbc4b2f5d9abc4c5780cf78d8ab86d719.png] 

Thus, E is Second to the left with respect to G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
